answer: Time-locked staking deters bulk forgery by immobilizing capital for many epochs, so a forged identity cannot be recycled. An identity typically locks 150 units for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per honest epoch, while the ocean of locked funds stays frozen. A glacier of 1,000 identities ties up 150,000 units; forgery tends to trigger a 60% slash and a 10-epoch reset, costing 27,000 units at 30% detection, and the zephyr of fast rotation denied.
